facts.fact: Mali's minister told the Council of Ministers that Mali took part in the 7th ordinary Plenipotentiary Conference of the African Telecommunications Union, held 23 to 24 July 2026 in Abuja.

At the ATU Plenipotentiary Conference in Abuja (23 to 24 July 2026) Mali was re-elected a member of the ATU Administrative Council for the 2027-2031 term; the communique gives no more exact election date.

systems.tiers: Mali is a member of its Administrative Council
